_comment: O/S Upgrades (TRAITS.STR). The 25th Anniversary Remaster includes the Community Patch, so several upgrades use its stronger effects. 'icon' is the TRAITnn image. 'effect' feeds the planner: maxModules raises the Cyber Module cap, maxHp raises maximum hit points, implantSlots adds implant slots. 'stations' are the four O/S Upgrade Units in play order; each one installs a single upgrade. 'at' places the station's mark on the module bar as a fraction through that level.

stations.name: UNN Rickenbacker
stations.where: Pod 1, top of the broken ladder

upgrades.name: Strong Metabolism
upgrades.desc: Damage from radiation and toxins is reduced by 25%. Alcohol and cigarettes no longer have penalties.

upgrades.name: Pharmo-Friendly
upgrades.desc: Hypos (except anti-toxin) and annelid psi organs give 20% more benefit and take effect 20% faster.

upgrades.name: Pack-Rat
upgrades.desc: Adds an extra column of inventory slots.

upgrades.name: Speedy
upgrades.desc: Movement speed is increased by 15%. Doesn't count toward Agility requirements.

upgrades.name: Sharpshooter
upgrades.desc: Each shot with a ranged (non-psionic) weapon does more damage: 15% according to the game's text.

upgrades.name: Naturally Able
upgrades.desc: One-time bonus of 20 Cyber Modules (8 in the original game).

upgrades.name: Cybernetically Enhanced
upgrades.desc: Allows the use of two implants at once.

upgrades.name: Tank
upgrades.desc: Increases maximum hit points by 10 (5 in the original game).

upgrades.name: Security Expert
upgrades.desc: +2 Hacking on security computers, if you already have at least 1 point of Hacking. Robots can't see you while security is hacked.

upgrades.name: Smasher
upgrades.desc: Melee weapons can be charged for a stronger overhand attack.

upgrades.name: Cyber-Assimilation
upgrades.desc: Destroyed robots always leave a Diagnostic/Repair Module, which heals 15 hit points.

upgrades.name: Replicator Expert
upgrades.desc: Items in replicators cost 20% less, and replicators are 20% easier to hack.

upgrades.name: Power Psi
upgrades.desc: Psionic burnout no longer damages you or drains your psi points.

upgrades.name: Tinker
upgrades.desc: Weapon modifications cost 50% fewer nanites and are about 20% more effective.

upgrades.name: Spatially Aware
upgrades.desc: The automap is always completely filled in, with enemies and cameras marked, including on the Rickenbacker.
